products.name: Ideogram
products.note: Text-in-image generation; typography AI; commercial use; IP and copyright considerations

profile_text.body:
Ideogram describes itself as a generative media platform that brings together purpose-built creative applications, image and video model access, and API infrastructure in a single product. Its unified API handles authentication, usage, and billing across supported image and video models, allowing developers to switch between models by changing a model string in a request.

The company's flagship offering is Ideogram 4.0, which it describes as an open model whose weights are available for local use and customization under an applicable license, while also remaining accessible through Ideogram's own platform. The tracked product, also called Ideogram, is categorized under image and graphic design, with noted capabilities in text-in-image generation and typography, along with commercial use availability and associated intellectual property and copyright considerations.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the held facts for Ideogram.
